Phase 1: The Pre-Flight Safety Check
This phase is from T.C. Hale (Kick Your Fat in the Nuts) and Stanley Rosenberg (Accessing the Healing Power of the Vagus Nerve), and the idea is that before you add "fuel" (supplements) or "fire" (antimicrobials), the engine has to be mechanically sound.
Check your autonomic tone (Hale). Are your pupils dilated all the time? Is your gag reflex missing? If so, you're in "Sympathetic Dominance" (fight/flight), and your digestion is offline.
So how do you get out of that? Rosenberg has you do the "Basic Exercise" (eye movements) or "The Salamander" to mechanically release the Vagus nerve and switch your body into "Rest and Digest."
Then check your bile flow (Hale again). If you burp after fatty meals, or your stools float or look clay-colored, your bile is stagnant, and taking antimicrobials now (that's the "fire") will cause a "herx" reaction you can't detoxify.
His fix there is Beet Flow or Phosphatidylcholine, to thin the bile before you start any killing protocol.
My notes: for stress and sleep see Severe stress above, and for stomach acid and bile see Low stomach acid.

Phase 2: The Reset
Dr. Michael Ruscio (Healthy Gut, Healthy You) and Dr. Mark Pimentel (The Microbiome Connection) are behind this phase. Here you bring down the inflammation and starve out the overgrowths, without any harsh chemicals.
Go on a Paleo-Low FODMAP diet (Ruscio) or a Low Fermentation Eating plan (Pimentel). Either one is meant to stop feeding the bacteria in your small intestine.
Pimentel has you space your meals strictly 4-5 hours apart, with no snacking. That way the Migrating Motor Complex (MMC) can sweep the gut clean.
My notes: see Poor diet now and Plant foods, above.

If you have an acute infection with something that those don't help quickly, consider escalating to secnidazole treatment for rapid cure, and paromomycin post-treatment for relapse prevention, with medical supervision.
BIND to the toxins, especially the metals and parasite die-off toxins, using Zholy3O.
At the same time, take Ruscio's Triple Probiotic Support, a blend of Lacto/Bifido, S. boulardii, and Soil-Based organisms. That's to maintain diversity and prevent opportunistic infections (like C. diff) during the kill phase.
And if the herbs failed, the overgrowth is too severe or the gut lining is too damaged for solids, so it's time for Ruscio's "Nuclear" Option, the Elemental Diet. That's a 2-3 week liquid-only diet (predigested nutrients), which starves the bacteria completely while still nourishing you.

We're back to Dr. William Davis for this one, plus Dr. Will Bulsiewicz (Fiber Fueled). Once you're clear of infection, you have to rebuild a diverse ecosystem so you don't relapse.

And fuel the mitochondria: see the fuels under Leaky gut, above (glutamine, butyrate and TCA intermediates).

b1-P6-B:
Phase 6: Refractory Cases
The last phase is from Neil Nathan (Toxic) and Annie Hopper (Wired for Healing). It's for people who are "sensitive to everything," or who relapse right away even though they've stuck to the protocol perfectly.
Check your environment (Nathan). Could it be mold/mycotoxins, or Lyme? Get assessed for those, and if it comes back positive, use specific binders (Cholestyramine, Charcoal, Clay).
Then check the brain. If you react to everything, Hopper says the issue is Limbic System Impairment, and you'd use "Brain Retraining" (DNRS) to stop the brain from firing false "danger" signals to the gut.
My notes: Matt's note on mopping up mycotoxins with fermented colostrum is under Leaky gut, above.
